name: Vica’s Cafe
notes: 3 photos, 3 distinct pages of the same printed menu (Specialties/Chilaquiles; Omelettes & Eggs/Sweet treats; Brunch/Little Ones). No prices are printed anywhere on the menu, so all dishes omit price.

dishes.name: Cazuela Norteña
dishes.description: Hot skillet layered with potatoes, beef chorizo, smothered with red salsa, topped with eggs, and micro cilantro, served with beans.

dishes.name: Benedictos Mexicanos
dishes.description: English muffin layered with beef chorizo, poached eggs, chipotle sauce and avocado, served with breakfast potatoes, and beans.

dishes.name: Steak and eggs
dishes.description: Grilled arrachera steak, eggs, topped with chimichurri sauce and avocado, served with breakfast potatoes.

dishes.name: Huevos en Salsa de Chicharron
dishes.description: Hot skillet layered with corn tortillas, refried beans, and eggs, smothered with chicharron in roasted tomatillo salsa, topped with red onion and cilantro, served with breakfast potatoes.

dishes.name: Tamal Frito con Huevo
dishes.description: Eggs, fried beef tamale, topped with your choice of green or red salsa, sour cream, cotija cheese, and refried beans.

dishes.name: Rojos
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips tossed in red salsa.

dishes.name: Verdes
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips tossed in roasted tomatillo salsa.

dishes.name: Poblanos
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips tossed in roasted poblano cream sauce.

dishes.name: Chipotle
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips tossed in spicy creamy chipotle sauce.

dishes.name: Birriaquiles
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips tossed in birria consomme, topped with slow braised birria beef, only served with a side of birria broth.

dishes.name: Build Your Own Omelette
dishes.description: Choice of veggies: avocado, mushrooms, spinach, onion, jalapenos, or tomato. Choice of cheese: Monterey Jack or panela. Choice of protein: ham, bacon, beef chorizo, or upgrade to arrachera steak. Served with breakfast potatoes.

dishes.name: Fitness Omelette
dishes.description: Egg white omelette filled with panela cheese, mushrooms, onion, and spinach, served with sliced avocado and side salad.

dishes.name: Poblano Omelette
dishes.description: Egg omelette filled with Monterrey Jack cheese, mushrooms, onion, corn, poblano peppers, topped with poblano cream sauce, and sour cream, served with breakfast potatoes and beans.

dishes.name: Huevos al Gusto
dishes.description: Choice of eggs, choice of protein: chorizo, bacon, or ham, served with breakfast potatoes, and beans.

dishes.name: Machaca con Huevo
dishes.description: Scrambled eggs with tender shredded beef, tomato, onion, and cilantro, served with breakfast potatoes and beans.

dishes.name: Huevos Rancheros
dishes.description: Fried corn tortillas topped with sunny side up eggs, and spicy red roasted salsa.

dishes.name: Pink Pancakes
dishes.description: Buttermilk pancakes, covered in house made strawberry sweet cream sauce, topped with fresh berries.

dishes.name: Pancakes de Naranja
dishes.description: Orange infused buttermilk pancakes, topped with house made whipped cream, and fig jam.

dishes.name: Pancakes de Elote
dishes.description: Sweet corn buttermilk pancakes, topped with whipped piloncillo butter, roasted corn kernels, and agave syrup drizzle.

dishes.name: Churro Waffle
dishes.description: Golden waffle dusted with cinnamon sugar, chocolate, and caramel drizzle, topped with fresh berries.

dishes.name: Dubai Mini Pancakes
dishes.description: Mini pancakes, topped with chocolate sauce, pistachio butter, kataifi and pistachio crumble.

dishes.name: Strawberry Salad
dishes.description: Spring greens, pecans, dried cranberries, fresh strawberries, feta cheese, and raspberry dressing. Add your choice of protein; chicken, arrachera steak, or salmon.

dishes.name: Serrano Toast
dishes.description: Toasted sourdough, mashed avocado, arugula, serrano ham, feta, and truffle oil drizzle.

dishes.name: Tacos de Birria
dishes.description: Crispy slow braised birria beef tacos, topped with cilantro, onion, served with side of consomme.

dishes.name: Enchiladas
dishes.description: Filled with your choice of protein, chicken, or cheese, smothered in green or red salsa, topped with sour cream, cotija cheese, pickled onions, and micro cilantro, served with beans.

dishes.name: Carne Tampiqueña
dishes.description: Grilled arrachera steak served with a red cheese enchilada, guacamole, house pico and beans.

dishes.name: Chicken Sandwich
dishes.description: Sourdough bread, american cheese, grilled chicken breast, bacon, avocado, and chipotle mayo.

dishes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
dishes.description: Toasted white bread with American cheese, served with french fries.

dishes.name: Kids Waffle
dishes.description: Golden waffle, with eggs cooked to your liking, and your choice of bacon or sausage links.

dishes.name: Kids Pancake
dishes.description: Buttermilk pancake with eggs cooked to your liking, and your choice of bacon or sausage links.
